races.paceDynamic: Angel Of Anfield and Albaydaa will ensure strong early gallop from the gates, both confirmed front-runners who won't yield easily. This contested pace will stretch the field and create a genuine test of stamina over the 7f trip at Ascot. The honest gallop will suit horses with tactical speed who can position handily without getting embroiled in the early battle. Hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks are favoured as the pace-setters will soften each other up for late closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If Angel Of Anfield and Albaydaa go too fast early and both weaken significantly
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses with proven finishing speed. Colori Forever and May Angel can use their class to sweep past tired leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Stay Strong
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders (likely Albaydaa) can sustain the gallop and resist late challenges
scenarios.body: The winner comes from those tracking the pace who can strike at the right moment. Prominent racers with tactical speed will be best placed to capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders settle into a more measured rhythm after initial skirmishing
scenarios.body: This becomes more of a sprint finish where horses with the highest turn of foot will prevail. The class horses get their chance to dominate.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Continues
scenarios.trigger: If Angel Of Anfield and Albaydaa maintain their battle throughout the race
scenarios.body: Both leaders will weaken dramatically, leaving the race wide open for any horse with finishing speed. Even the outsiders could capitalize on the collapse.

watchPoints.text: Angel Of Anfield returning after 212 days could be rusty early and fail to lead as expected
Albaydaa might get an uncontested lead if Angel Of Anfield doesn't fire fresh, completely changing race shape
May Angel and Colori Forever both hold-up horses who need the pace to develop - watch for early positioning
Aqua Bear and Queen Tamara both returning from very long breaks, market support will indicate readiness
Synners Kid has history of fading in finish - early position will reveal if connections expect improvement

races.paceDynamic: Elements Of Fire will lead this field as the sole confirmed front-runner, with Mandurah, Photosynthesis, Kodiac Thriller and Hucklesbrook sitting prominent behind. The early pace should be controlled and sustainable with no pressure on Elements Of Fire through the first half of this 6f contest. The lack of early speed will create a tactical affair that builds steadily, with the final 2f becoming crucial as the field bunches up. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and strong finishers who can capitalize on the modest early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Elements Of Fire leads uncontested and the pace stays modest through halfway
scenarios.body: The field will remain tightly bunched turning for home, creating a sprint finish that favours horses with tactical speed and strong finishing kicks. Hold-up horses like Toyotomi, Brosay and Bolo Neighs get the perfect setup to unleash late runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Creates Gaps
scenarios.trigger: If Mandurah, Photosynthesis or Kodiac Thriller apply early pressure to Elements Of Fire
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will string out the field and create gaps for horses positioned just off the pace to exploit. Those sitting handy but not committed early will have the tactical advantage in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Elements Of Fire gets completely uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The leader's recent winning form at 7f suggests stamina reserves that could prove decisive over 6f with a soft lead. Late closers may struggle to peg back a horse who has been allowed to dictate throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Into Bunched Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early tempo is exceptionally slow with multiple horses still in contention at the furlong pole
scenarios.body: A messy, stop-start affair will favor horses with natural speed and tactical pace rather than pure finishing kicks. Those who can quicken from any position will have the edge.

races.paceDynamic: Sizzling Seixas, Dublin Bay, Who Is Alice and Bellini Spirit will ensure a genuine gallop from the start in this competitive 6f handicap. With 8 prominent runners including Hallo Spaceboy, Blue Orbit, Rogue Temptation, Moscow Power, Fair Y Isle, Empress Olivia and Arry Up all wanting forward positions, severe congestion is inevitable approaching the 2f marker. The strong early pace will set up perfectly for the hold-up brigade to sweep through tired leaders in the final furlong. This race shape strongly favours closers and hold-up horses who can navigate the traffic and produce their best when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Sweep
scenarios.trigger: If the front four go too fast and the prominent pack gets squeezed 2f out
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will find out stamina limitations while traffic problems stall the prominent runners, allowing patient hold-up horses with clear runs to come through strongly. Night Mission and Secret Santa are perfectly positioned to benefit from this chaos.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is more controlled and the prominent pack avoid traffic
scenarios.body: The 8 prominent runners get first run on the leaders while maintaining good positions throughout, with tactical speed proving decisive over pure finishing kick. Hallo Spaceboy and Moscow Power can make their class tell from ideal positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If all front runners stop quickly and prominent runners also tire
scenarios.body: The early gallop takes its toll across the board, leaving the race to be won by whichever horse finds the best late surge from midfield or worse. Form horses with proven stamina at the trip become crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Sizzling Seixas or Dublin Bay get soft sectionals early
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters steals a march while the prominent pack neutralise each other, holding on grimly as closers charge but fall just short. Recent form and fitness become decisive factors.

watchPoints.text: Severe traffic problems 2f out with 8 prominent runners including Hallo Spaceboy, Blue Orbit, Rogue Temptation converging on limited space
Sizzling Seixas and Dublin Bay setting unsustainable fractions if they duel early, compromising both chances
Secret Santa's fitness after 336-day layoff despite strong previous form showing 3-3-4 finishes
Night Mission and other hold-up horses needing clear passage in the final 2f when field bunches
Moscow Power's ability to follow up recent win when stepping up significantly in grade

races.paceDynamic: Outback Heat, Northern Empire, and Arbaawy will set a strong gallop from the start, creating a genuine test of stamina over this straight mile. The pace will be honest throughout with multiple leaders vying for position early, stretching the field and putting pressure on front runners. This sustained gallop will expose any stamina limitations and create opportunities for strong finishers with tactical speed. The race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and those with proven stamina who can finish strongly off a solid pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Hold-Up Win
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners maintain a strong gallop to halfway
scenarios.body: The pace will collapse in the final two furlongs, allowing closers with tactical speed to sweep past tiring leaders. Hold-up horses like Spirit Of Saxony and Luzon Heights can capitalize on their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter gets first run on rivals turning for home
scenarios.body: A single front runner will establish a decisive advantage while others falter, holding on despite late pressure from closers. Blue Courvoisier's recent form and prominent style make him best placed to benefit.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Mid-Race Move
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate allowing tactical positioning
scenarios.body: Prominent runners can position perfectly and kick clear before hold-up horses get organized, creating a decisive winning move. King's Trust and Tiger Power have the class to execute this tactical approach effectively.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three front runners go too fast and all tire dramatically
scenarios.body: The entire field will come back to the closers in a bunched finish where pure class tells in the final furlong. This suits the strongest finishers who can produce their best when the pace truly collapses.

watchPoints.text: Outback Heat and Northern Empire may set unsustainable fractions that compromise their finishing chances while setting up closers

Blue Courvoisier's prominent running style could prove ideal if he can track the pace without getting involved in early speed battle
Spirit Of Saxony's hold-up style depends entirely on the front runners creating sufficient pace to come back to him
Luzon Heights dropping significantly in grade represents clear value if the pace scenario develops favorably

races.paceDynamic: Calvert will lead from the gate with no genuine pace pressure, allowing Taryn Langley to dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages. Circuit Breaker and Aajej may track in second and third, but neither has the natural speed to challenge Calvert's dominance early. The lack of genuine pace horses means this will develop into a tactical affair with a strong finish, as the large field of hold-up horses including Naval Tribute, Expressionless, and Educator will be winding up late. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can position close enough to the pace without getting caught in the inevitable traffic problems that will affect the back-markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Calvert gets soft fractions and stays on strongly from the front
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the leader to conserve energy and resist the late charge from hold-up horses. Calvert's recent form shows consistency in similar tactical scenarios.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The tactical nature creates a blanket finish where class and finishing kick matter most. Naval Tribute and Expressionless have shown strong finishing ability in recent wins.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Circuit Breaker or Aajej can track the leader and pounce late
scenarios.body: The prominent runners avoid traffic issues while staying close enough to challenge, benefiting from Calvert's honest pace-making. Circuit Breaker's recent third suggests readiness for this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant interference in the straight
scenarios.body: A horse drawn wide or getting a clear run benefits while others are stuck behind faltering horses. Tarbat Ness or Lusaka could emerge from the pack if others are hampered.

watchPoints.text: Calvert must prove stamina at this extended 2-mile trip having never won beyond 14 furlongs previously
Traffic problems will be severe in the straight with 10+ hold-up horses trying to make late runs from similar positions
Circuit Breaker and Aajej need to position close enough to Calvert early without getting caught wide or using too much energy
Naval Tribute's finishing kick could be decisive if the pace collapses but needs clear running room in the final furlong
Apprentice jockeys on five runners including the likely leader Calvert may affect tactical positioning and race development
